# MixedLabyrinthFractal

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A class of fractal structures generated by randomized recursive labyrinth patterns that combine multiple maze-generation rules into a single self-similar topology. Provides a tunable, high-complexity network topology generator for TCC/iNEST, enabling exploration of routing and neuromorphic dynamics on non-Euclidean, self-similar substrates.
